Add your report

Upload an image, then click Analyse report.

For report analysis, choose a clear photo of the written report. English printed text is supported. A designated demo image opens a labelled, predefined kidney-stone example; scan image diagnosis is not supported. PDFs, HEIC and handwriting are not supported.

Results use automatically extracted text and are unverified. Open “Report text” below to compare with your image. Correct any errors, especially measurements and words such as “no”, then click Analyse report again.

Image text is read on your device. The OCR engine downloads from public CDNs on first use; your image is not sent to an OCR service.

Problems & possible solutions

Upload. Analyse. Understand.

Upload a written report image and click Analyse report to see matched problems and possible care options.

Understand the limits. This is a rule-based research demonstration, not a validated AI medical service. It recognizes four example finding groups: kidney stones, fatty liver, wrist/arm fractures, and explicitly reported anemia. It does not diagnose, prescribe, assess emergencies, or interpret scan images. Unmatched text needs clinical review; an empty result does not mean a normal report.
Built for understanding. For review with your doctor.No account, server-side report storage, or external AI calls.
